name: diagramzu
description: diagramzu-mcp lets an AI client (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, etc.) author Mermaid diagrams in a shared workspace that a team can read, comment on, embed, and present at a clean URL — rather than just generating a one-off diagram. Hosted endpoint https://mcp.diagramzu.ai/mcp or local npx -y @diagramzu/m
